ifuto-zoom.config.title: Ifuto Zoom Settings
ifuto-zoom.config.hint: Default key: C — scroll while zooming to change the zoom level
ifuto-zoom.config.mode.tooltip: Hold: zoom only while the key is held down. Toggle: press once to zoom in, press again to zoom out.
ifuto-zoom.config.easing.tooltip: Speed curve of the zoom. The default starts fast and keeps slowing down, both when zooming in and when zooming back out.
ifuto-zoom.config.scroll_to_zoom.tooltip: Use the scroll wheel while zooming to zoom in (unlimited) or out (down to the minimum zoom).
ifuto-zoom.config.keep_zoom_level.toolti: Keep the scrolled zoom level after the zoom ends instead of resetting it to the zoom factor.
ifuto-zoom.config.reduce_sensitivity.too: Slow the mouse down while zoomed in so aiming stays precise.
